articles.title: Trump accord calls for tech firms to ‘self police’ their own frontier AI
articles.snippet: The voluntary accord puts much of the responsibility for managing frontier AI risks on developers.

articles.title: Trump Unveils 'Morally Binding' AI Accord Signed by OpenAI, Google and Nvidia
articles.snippet: The one-page pact, which Trump called "morally binding," asks companies to adopt internal controls, independent audits and board oversight—but carries no penalties and drew criticism for its thin detail.

articles.title: Bitcoin Falls Lower as Trump's Iran Snub Sends Oil, Yields Higher
articles.snippet: Bitcoin extends last week's pullback as Trump rejects Iran's ceasefire plan, sending oil above $100 and yields higher ahead of Wednesday's PCE report.
